title: Elara — Chapter 1: Farz
subtitle: Dushman ki princess chains mein… aur key tumhare paas hai.

lines: Wo tumhe pehli roshni mein lene aate hain. Dungeon nahi — guardhouse ke paas bina khidki ka kamra, aur darwaza khulte hi tumhara dil ruk jata hai: beech ke khambe se bandhi Nessa hai.

Chheh mahine baad pehli baar dekh rahe ho. Patli, peeli, kapda phata — par zinda, aur jab wo tumhe dekhti hai to uska dara chehra itni poori raahat se sikudta hai ki tum almost ghutnon par gir padte ho.
"Tum aa gaye," wo saans mein kehti hai. "Mujhe pata tha tum—"

"Chup," Vance kehta hai, kone se aate hue. Wo table pe rakhi chhadi pe haath rakhta hai. "Princess ke paas ek raaz hai jo dard hila nahi paya. To hum use ek wajah denge jo bilkul uske baare mein nahi." Wo tumhari taraf chhadi badhata hai, handle pehle. "Bees waar. Tum maaroge. Phir princess ko bilkul bataoge tumne kya kiya, aur usse bheekh mangoge ki ye rukwa de."
"Nahi," tum khud ko kehte sunte ho. "Mujhe le lo badle mein—"

"Tumhe dard dena kuch nahi karega," Vance bina pareshani kehta hai. "Par *us* ko dard dena — wo cheez princess *tumhare* andar se bardasht nahi kar payegi. Chhadi lo, warna main use kisi aise aadmi ko dunga jo maza lega, aur phir chalis waar."
Wahi hisab jo pehli raat se tumhe dabaye hue hai. Tumhare haath se bees waar, jitne halka tum himmat kar sako — ya kisi aur se kai guna bura.
Tum chhadi lete ho, haath kampte hue. Nessa ghumti hai tumhara chehra dhoondhne, aur jab samajh jati hai, cheekhti nahi. Sambhal jati hai.

"Theek hai," aansuon ke beech kehti hai. "Maine warning khurach di thi. Main jaanti hoon ye tum nahi ho, jaise uske saath bhi tum nahi the. Tumhara haath unke haath se behtar hai. Kar do. Main bees jhel sakti hoon." Wo chehra wapas khambe ki taraf karti hai, kandhe set karti hai aur intezaar karti hai — unnees saal ki, usse zyada bahadur jo kabhi hona chahiye tha.
Pehla waar tum jitna halka himmat karte ho utna hi karte ho — phir bhi padta hai, aur uski peeth pe aag ki ek patli lakeer khil uthti hai. "Ek," Vance ginta hai.

Tum khud ko doosra, teesra karne pe majboor karte ho. Paanchve tak wo khullam-khulla ro rahi hoti hai; aathve tak cheekhein chhoti-chhoti beikhtiyar binti ban jati hain — tumse nahi, bas shareer duniya se keh raha hai dard rok do.

Aadhe raaste wo phir tumhari aankhein dhoondhti hai, aansu behte, aur phir bhi tumhe pakadne ko kuch dena chahti hai. "Chalte raho," wo haanfkar kehti hai. "Tumse poore bees, *us* se ek minute zyada nahi. Mere saath raho. Mere saath gino."
Tum dimaag mein uske saath ginte ho, barah, terah, chaudah, har number chhoti niji maafi jo kabhi kaafi nahi hogi. Vance dekhata hai jaise koi aadmi apna nazariya confirm kar raha ho.

Bees pe tum chhadi gira dete ho aur faisla hone se pehle hi khambe pe pahunch jate ho, use thaamte hue jab wo tumhari bahon mein jhukti hai. Kampati, daag-wale, par zinda aur hoshiyar, aur pehli cheez jo karti hai wo tumhari sleeve jakadna. "Dekha? Bees. Kaha tha. Hum theek hain."

"Bada pyara," Vance kehta hai, apni chhadi uthate hue. "Ise wapas le jao," wo sipahiyon se kehta hai, aur darwaza uske peeche band hota hai, tumhe superintendent aur abhi bachi lambi walk ke saath chhodkar.
"Ab," Vance kehta hai, coat jhadte hue. "Neeche princess ke paas. Jo kiya sab batao, koi detail mat chhodo — main guards se poochhunga. Aur phir bheekh mango."

"Iska shape samajh lo. Aaj bees waar the. Kal aur bura hoga, har din badhta, jab tak wo mujhe Everspring na de ya hafta khatam na ho aur hum use phansi na de dein. Tumhare paas chheh din hain use ek zindagi bachane pe raazi karne ko. Main kehta hoon, convincing bano."

Saat seedhiyan kabhi itni lambi nahi lagi thin. Elara tumhare boots pe sir uthaati hai, phir tumhara chehra dekhti hai, khoon jo tumhara nahi, aur uska expression badal jata hai. "Unhone kya kiya," wo kehti hai. Sawal nahi.
To tum ghutne tekte ho aur bataate ho. Nessa ke baare mein, khamba, chhadi, bees waar jo tumhare khud ke haath ne diye. Tum dekhte ho har shabd uspe alag waar ki tarah padta hai.

Jab tum khatam karte ho, Elara chup rehti hai, phir bahut dheemi aur steady awaaz mein: "To ye uska khel hai. Meri body se tod nahi paya, to tumhari se todega. Uski se." Aankhein band. "Meri khud ki khal pe koi aisa torture nahi jo use chhue jaise ye soch — ki meri khamoshi ki wajah se wo ladki chhadi ke neeche hai."
Aankhein kholti hai, geeli aur tez. "Ab tum mujhse bheekh mangoge. Usne kaha hai. To mango. Khatam karo."

Aur tum nahi mang sakte. Sach mein bheekh mangna ye maangna hai ki wo duniya ke sabse zalim aadmi ko kabhi na marne ki taakat de de, aur tumhare andar dar se behtar hissa muh se wo binti nahi nikalne deta.

"Main nahi kar sakta," iske bajaye whisper karte ho. "Maine use *dekha* hai. Agar aisa aadmi kabhi na mare— lekin wo meri behen hai, unnees saal ki, aur mujhe nahi *pata* kya karun. Poori zindagi mein pehli baar mujhe nahi pata kya karun." Tum sir jhukate ho, aur ek bada aadmi dungeon ke floor pe toot jata hai.

Elara jitna chains allow karti hain utna aage jhukti hai, awaaz us kale jagah ki sabse naram cheez. "Tum bheekh nahi mangoge, aur main nahi tootoongi — aaj nahi. Hum is aadmi se tez hain, aur hum use pehle din panick karke jeetne nahi denge."

"Chheh din," wo whisper karti hai. "Usne humein chheh din diye hain teesra raasta dhoondhne ko — jo na meri khamoshi se use maare, na mere raaz se duniya ko barbaad kare. Hamesha teesra raasta hota hai. Mujhe dhoondhne mein madad karo."
Us raat tum seedhiyan chadhte ho bina kisi hal ke, aur peeche andhere mein, pehli baar, princess marne ka intezaar nahi kar rahi. Wo plan banana shuru karti hai.
— Chapter 11 khatam —

Doosra din. Mashalein badalne se pehle hi aa gaye, aur Elara ki cell mein nahi — nange kamre mein, floor pe naali aur lamba lohe ka trough, itna thanda paani ki kinaron pe baraf jam gayi thi. Vance pehle se wahan tha. Uske bagal stool se bandhi, wahi phata kapda pehne, Nessa thi.
Unnees saal ki, kalaiyan peeche bandhi, hoth pehle se is thand ki raat se neele-gehre, aankhein tumhe dhoondhti hue — darr jo tumhare khatir nigalne ki koshish karti hai.
"Accha. Bhai." Vance ne barafili satah pe do ungliyan ghumayi. "Thand magistrate ko dikhane ko kuch nahi chhodti, aur bhai ko yaad rakhne ko sab kuch."

"Tum use paani ke neeche doge. Main nahi. Tum. Har baar main sawal poochhun aur khamoshi pasand na aaye, uska chehra paani mein jayega, aur tum das tak ginte rahoge jab wo thodi dubegi. Aur jab se bardasht nahi hoga, neeche jaakar princess se kahoge — behen ko sukhane ka ek hi raasta hai, mujhe batao Everspring kahan hai."
"Mujhe nahi pata wo kahan hai. Main guard hoon," tumne kaha.
"Bilkul nahi pata. Main tumse poochh nahi raha — tumhe *istemaal* kar raha hoon. Wo bolegi taaki tumhe ye na karna pade." Usne trough ki taraf ishara kiya. "Shuru karo."
Kamre mein do aur aadmi khade the. Tumhe beemar saafai se samajh aa gaya — agar tum mana karoge to wo khud karenge, aur das tak nahi ginenge.

To tum behen ke peeche ghutne teke aur uske patle kandhon pe haath rakhe. "Nessa," tumne saans mein kaha. "Jab dabaaun to saans rok lena. Main upar laaunga. Kasam." Usne sir hilaya — ek chhoti, kampti haan — aur tumhare andar kuch toot gaya jo tab se juda nahi.
"Everspring kahan hai?" Vance ne khali hawa se poocha. Khamoshi. "Neeche."
Tumne apni hi behen ka chehra baraf ke paani mein dabaya aur gina jab wo tadapti rahi, upar khincha haanfati aur zinda, aur Vance ne phir kaha, aur tumne phir kiya.

Chaar baar. Paanch. Tum bhool gaye kitni baar tumne bachi hui iklauti khoon ko dubaya aur wapas laaya. Beech mein wo tumhara naam sisakti — kabhi ilzaam mein nahi, wo asahaniya tha — jaise koi baccha us ek se kahe jo rokne wala maana jata hai: please, rok do.
"Subah ko itna kaafi," Vance ne aakhir mein kaha, bore hote hue. "Neeche jao. Bheekh mango. Jab wo reason pe aane ko taiyar ho, wapas aana."
Wapas le jaane se pehle tumhe Nessa ko apne coat mein lapetne diya — iklauti reham jo jeet sake. Phir tum Elara ke andhere mein utre, sleeves bheegi, nahi jaante kaise kahoge.
Usne paani ki awaaz sun li pehle, jaise hamesha. "Tum geele ho," dheere kaha. "Unhone tumse kya karwaya."

Aur tumne bataaya — trough, baraf, tumhare khud ke haath, Nessa tumhara naam kehti. Wo sirf tumhari awaaz se le sakti thi, jo khud ek zulm hai. Jab tum bole, tumne mehsoos kiya wo chains mein bilkul sthir ho gayi.

"Wo use torture nahi kar raha," aakhir mein kaha, dheemi aur samajh se bhari bhayankar awaaz. "Wo *tumhe* torture kar raha hai. Uske through, mere through — instruments jinpe bajakar wo note dhoondhta hai jo mera muh khulwaye. Wo bahut accha hai. To ab hum aise nahi ladenge. Abhi se, hum wo ek kaam karenge jiska wo intezaar nahi kar raha."
"Kaunsa kaam," tumne kaha.
"Hum *dekhna* shuru karte hain. Chheh din — wo todne ke liye kehta rehta hai. Main use istemaal karungi. Har baar jab wo tumhe neeche bheje toda jaane, tum mere liye kamra laoge."

"Jab in hall mein chalte ho, toota aadmi bheekh mangta — use yakeen rehne do. Par bheekh mangte hue tum *gino.* Pahre ki badli pe seedhi ke guards. Mashalein kab badalti hain aur chaabiyan kaun le jata hai. Thandi hawa kahan se aati hai — bahar ka raasta, hamesha. Upar ki beam pe rassi, us nange kamre ki naali, darwaza jo wo kabhi poori tarah bolt nahi karte."

"Abhi kuch plan mat banao. Bas mujhe kamra laate raho, tukda-tukda, jab tak main andhere mein bhi chal sakun. Raat ki badli pe guards gino. Kal mujhe wo lao. Hamare paas chheh din hain, aur main unhe gham pe kharch nahi karungi."
Us raat tum seedhi chadhe, sleeves abhi bhi geeli — lekin pehli baar, ginte hue. Niche landing pe do guards, upar ek, teesri watch pe mashal wala, baayin kamar pe chaabiyan.
Chhoti cheezein. Kuch nahi jaisi. Sab kuch ki shuruaat. Chheh mein se doosra din khatam — chaar aur, aur ek sipahi jo aakhir, chupke se, jeetne ka faisla kar chuka tha.
— Chapter 12 khatam —

Trough ke baad ke din ek dhoosar dard mein ghul gaye. Vance ka lever — chhadi, thand, bheekh ka chakra — kaam nahi aa raha tha. Chauthe din raja ne poore design se sabr kho diya: khabar aayi Nessa table se hata di gayi, sadharan cell mein, khana mila, chhua nahi gaya.

Iska matlab tumhare gale ki rassi bhi dheeli pad gayi. Un dhundhli raaton mein tum Elara ko kamra laate rahe, tukda-tukda — pahre ki badli, chaabiyan, eenton se band naali ki thandi hawa — jab tak bhagna almost taiyar na ho gaya.
Phir unhone kaha phansi subah set hai — aur aaj raat, raja khud neeche aa raha hai use aakhri baar poochhne.

King Mordane bina shor-sharabe ke aaya — lamba, dheema aadmi, sadhe wool mein, kandhe pe ek mage, chaar sipahi kapde ke neeche kuch bhaari uthaye. Thaka clerk lagta tha. Uske baare mein sabse daraane wali baat yahi thi.
"To ye wahi hai," usne kaha, chains mein Elara ko dekhte hue. "Kahaniyon se chhoti." Aankhein tum pe. "Aur ye wo hai jo usse lag gaya. Ruk. Main ek gawah chahta hoon jo mehsoos kare."
Sipahiyon ne kapda hataya — kale lohe ka tedha frame, uski dhanush upar zalim tip tak. Palna, agar palna us cheez ko todne ke liye bana ho jo wo thaame.

"Patti utaro," raja ne kaha. "Main chahta hoon wo dekhe uska khud ka raja kitna reason kar raha hai." Aur tumse: "Inki madad karo, use ispe litane mein. Suna hai tumhare haath naram hain. Unka use karo. Ye aakhri narmi hogi jo use kisi se milegi."

Unhone tumhe majboor kiya uski kamar ki seedh lohe ki tip pe rakhne, kalaiyan ek taraf, takhne doosri, jab tak poora shareer curve pe peeche na mud jaye. Usne awaaz nahi nikali — sirf tumhari aankhein dhoondhin aur thaame rakha: tumhara qasoor nahi, hum khatam nahi hue.
Phir sipahiyon ne cuff se wazan lagaaye, arch gehra hua, aur seene pe aadhe bharte lash-daag phat gaye, taza khoon lohe pe behta. Usne daant ke beech se haanfkar pehli awaaz di.

Raja jhuka, aur chhota mitti ka jar nikaala. "Namak aur sirka," kaha, tumhari taraf badhate hue. "Sabse naram haath tumhare hain, to ye tumhara hi kaam. Mana kiya to mage karega, aur tumhe uske bagal mein chabuk lagenge. Jaldi choose karo."

To tumhare haathon ne uske seene ki phati lakeeron mein namak aur sirka daala, aur jo cheekh nikli usne dungeon bhar diya. Wo jaanti thi tum ho, aur phir bhi ilzaam nahi diya. "Everspring kahan hai, Elara?" raja ne uski cheekhon ke upar poocha, jaise koi time poochhe.

Wo lohe pe royi aur kampi, aur jab shabd bana paayi, wo nahi the jo usne chahe. "Tumhe mujhse kuch nahi milega, clerk-raja. Spring mere saath mar jaayegi. Jo aadmi hamesha jeena chahe, use *kabhi* nahi milna chahiye."
Mordane ke thake chehre pe kuch chala — gussa nahi. Almost izzat. Gusse se bhi bura.

Raja ne gussa nahi kiya. Sir hilaya, jaise usne kuch confirm kar diya ho, aur jar wapas tumhare haath mein dabaya. "Phir, aur gehra. Aur meri offer suno, Princess — main ek baar kehta hoon. Ek shabd, aur subah phansi nahi. Ek shaant kamra, ek khidki, tumhari behen Liora hamesha safe. Bolo, aur tum dono saans lete hue bahar nikaloge."
"Daalo," usne dheere kaha. "Use namak ke saath sochne do."

To tumne phir daala, aur wo phir cheekhi, tedha shareer chains pe tadapta — aur phir, aur phir. "Everspring kahan hai?" Chhuna. Cheekh. "Liora, safe. Ek zindagi." Chhuna. Cheekh. Usne kabhi awaaz nahi uthayi, yakeen ke saath ki agar tum kaafi shaant raho to har koi tootta hai.

Tum wahan khade us aurat mein dard daalte rahe jisse tum pyar karte the, kyunki doosra raasta tha mage ke zyada zalim haath aur uske bagal wala frame. Aur wo nahi tooti — na namak pe, na zindagi ki offer pe, na raja ke muh mein Liora ke naam pe. Peeche jhuki, seena khula, usne spring nahi di.
Raja seedha hua. "Aur wazan. Bade patthar. Kalaiyon aur takhnon dono pe — main chahta hoon uski reedh seekhe wo kis se jhagad rahi hai."

Tum aur ek sipahi ne quarry ke patthar cuff se lagaaye, aur har ek ke saath arch usse aage gehra hua jahan shareer bana nahi hota, reedh tani khal ke neeche khadi. Har ek pe usne awaaz di jo tum zindagi bhar sunoge.
Chaar patthar latke, raja ne khula haath uski tanti pet pe rakha. "Tum kabhi na khade hone se ek ungli door ho, Princess. Ek aur patthar, ya chaar shabd — *yeh yahan hai* — aur naam."

"Ek," usne kaha. "Do." Aur *teen* pe — jab tum paanchve patthar bahon mein jamaye khade the — usne saans khinchi aur dhaage jaisi awaaz mein kaha: "Pehle... jala doongi." Uske sabr mein kuch aakhir patla pada.

Wo khada hua, aur boot ka tala uske nange gale pe rakha — dheere, naap ke, windpipe pe dabav badhate hue jab wo atki thi aur sir nahi ghumaa sakti thi. Chehra gehra pada; tum aadha kadam bade, pehle sipahi ke bhalle ke dande ne seene pe rok liya.

Bilkul kinare pe usne boot uthaya, use ek saans khurachne di, aur naram se poocha: "Everspring kahan hai?" Usne kuch nahi kaha. Teen baar usne use andhere ke kinare tak liya, aur teen baar usne hawa ke badle khamoshi di.

Raja pehle ruka, reham se nahi. Tumhare haath se khali jar liya aur use aise dekha jaise hairani ho. "Gyarah saal se main us paani ka shikar kar raha hoon, aur aakhri darwaza ek ladki hai jo kholne se pehle jalna pasand karegi."
"Par main sabr wala hoon, aur ek raat bachi hai. Use isi pe chhod do, bilkul aise — patthar rahenge, tedh pan rahega. Aur main nahi chahta wo soye. Basin laga do."
Unhone uske upar taambe ka basin tanga jisme chhed the, aur tumse tapakta uthwaya — thanda paani raat bhar ulte chehre aur kachche zakhmon pe girta, itni baar ki wo neend mein kabhi nahi ja paayi.

"Subah tak," raja ne kaha, pehle boond girte dekhte hue, "ya to wo mujhe spring degi, ya shehar ko shaant phansi. Dono kaam aate hain." Seedhi pe ruka, almost khud se: "Afsoos. Is poore qile mein wahi iklauti imandaar cheez thi."
Phir wo chala gaya. "Tumhara kaam ho gaya, naram haath," Vance ne kaha, tumhe seedhiyon pe lete hue jab do naye guards ne pahra sambhala. "Subah use wapas paoge, jo bachega, rassi tak le jaane."

Tum lambi seedhi chadhe, basin ki tip-tip andhere mein peeche aati — boot mein aadhi-kati key aur sone ki dawai, aur do naye guards ke paar us tak pahunchne ka koi raasta nahi. Subah phansi thi. Tum bhi nahi soye.
— Chapter 13 khatam —

Subah dhoosar aur pakki aayi. Unhone use cradle se utara — teen din bina neend, ek raat peeche jhuke, ab wo mushkil se khadi ho paati thi; reedh ek saath seedhi nahi hoti thi, har stage pe awaaz nikalwati. Unhone use aadha uthakar bahar roshni mein laaya jo usne hafte se nahi dekhi thi.
Poora shehar aa gaya tha, chowk kandhe se kandha bhar, aur jab wo dikhi, aankhein meechti tootiti, jo awaaz unhone nikali wo insan ki nahi thi — das hazaar gale ki nafrat ki deewar.

Unhone use scaffold pe rassi ke neeche khada kiya. King Mordane ne ek haath uthaya aur chowk chup ho gaya. "Rajdhani ke logon, is aurat se ek cheez maangi gayi thi jo uski zindagi kharid leti. Main ek baar aur poochhunga, jahan tum sab sun sako." Wo uski taraf muda. "Everspring, Elara. Bolo, aur jeeti ho. Chup raho, to ye ache log tumhe girte dekhenge."

Usne sir uthaya, aur poore chowk ko apna barbaad chehra dikhaya. "Tumhara raja hamesha jeena chahta hai. Yahi raaz hai jiske liye usne mujhe teen hafte torture kiya. Suraksha nahi — *hamesha.* Khud se poocho, aisa aadmi hazaar saal kya karega." Wo dagmagayi, sambhali. "Main aaj marungi taaki wo na kar sake. Ye sabse accha tohfa hai jo main tumhare bacchon ko kabhi dungi. Rassi kheench do."

Ye raja ke haq mein galat baat thi. Bheed mein gungunahat phaili — bechaini ki chhoti lehar, das hazaar dimaagon mein ek sawal: *hamesha?* Wo rassi ko martyr nahi bana sakta tha jab wo shabd hawa mein latka ho.
"Nahi," usne kaha, haath neeche karte hue. "Jaldi girna uske hisab se bahut saaf hai jo usne kamaya. Aaj wo *tumhara* hisab degi."
Unhone use scaffold ke kinare pillory mein jakad diya — bhaari oak frame gardan aur kalaiyan dabaye, use jhuka aur majboor khada rakhta.

"Teen hafte mere sawaliyon ke paas thi, kuch nahi mila," raja chillaya. "Shayad jinhe usne nuksan diya wo behtar karen. Ye yahan khadi rahegi shaam tak. Sirf maregi nahi — phansi mera haq hai, jab main chahun."
Usne tumhe aur guards ki line pillory ke pair pe lagayi — uski raksha ke liye nahi, apni property ki raksha ke liye. Tumhare orders: mob ko use maarne se roko, aur usse kam sab kuch hone do.
To tum us aurat aur us shehar ke beech khade rahe jo use marna chahta tha, talwar sirf is liye ijazat thi ki use buri maut tak zinda rakho.

Wo baadh ki tarah aaye — sade phal, gandagi, thook — poora shehar apni nafrat ek aurat pe khaali karta jo aankh ponchhne ko haath bhi nahi utha sakti thi. Ek boodhe ne switch se chehre pe maara jab tak guard ne peeche na dhakela.

Kuch ne ye kamaya tha — wo aurat jo phenkte hue ro rahi thi, wo aadmi jo har patthar pe bete ka naam leta tha. Elara ne unke khet jalaaye the. Us chowk ka gham sach tha, aur koi saaf jagah nahi thi jahan khade raho.

Dopahar tak ek aurat shears leke chadhi aur shor ke saath baal kaat diye; wo keechad mein gire aur kuchle gaye. Phenke cobble ne maathe ko khola aur khoon aankhon mein behne laga jo wo ponchh nahi sakti thi — aur phir bhi, har ghante, wo jakda sir oak jitna allow karta utna uthati aur unka saamna karti, unke aage nahi roti, bheekh nahi mangti.

Do baar aadmiyon ne maarne wale patthar phenke. Dono baar tum bina soche hil gaye — shield ne ek liya, doosre ka baaju hataya. Usne mehsoos kiya. Ek baar, jab kaafi paas the, phate hothon se do shabd saans mein, sirf tumse: "Abhi nahi." Keh rahi thi thaame raho — das hazaar gawahon ke saamne use bachane mein sab barbaad mat karo.
Ye chalta raha jab tak roshni amber na ho gayi aur bheed ke haath thak na gaye. Shaam tak chowk khali ho raha tha, aur pillory mein jo bacha tha wo mushkil se hilta tha.

Vance use kholne aaya. "Abhi saans le rahi hai," usne note kiya, barbaad chehra thodi se uthate hue. "Raja ne rassi ka naya din set nahi kiya. Jab tootogi tab phansi, usse pehle nahi. Kal ho sakta hai. Bahut, bahut lambi der bhi."

Unhone use andhere mein utaar liya, aur tum wo the jinhone gandagi aur khoon dhoya, haath kamapte. Dono ne wo nahi kaha jo ab dono jaante the: koi phansi ki tareekh nahi bachi jisse *pehle* bhaga jaaye — sirf khule din jisme raja use tab tak dard dega jab tak usse mar na jaye, kisi schedule pe nahi, bas uske sabr pe.
Jo clock tum bhaag rahe the wo gayab ho gayi. Aur jis aadmi ke paas deadline nahi, wo perfect raat ka intezaar nahi karta — wo khud ek banata hai.

Us raat aakhir wo soi, shareer ki wo marri neend jisme kuch nahi bacha, nanga sir tumhari god mein, tumhari peeth cell ke darwaze ki taraf — jab tum jaagte baithe guards ginte, pahre ki badli, eent wali naali ki thandi saans, ungliyon mein aadhi-kati key ghumate.

— Chapter 16 khatam —

"Wo humein ye DE rahi hai!" behen tumhare kandhe pe sisaki. "Ise barbaad mat karna. Mat banana ki usne ye bekaar mein kiya — BHAGO, bhai, bhago, BHAGO!"

To tum mud gaye. Ye sabse mushkil kaam tha jo tumne kabhi kiya, aur zindagi bhar uthoge: tumne princess ki peeth ki jo baarish mein akele lad rahi thi, aur bhaage, behen ka haath mutthi mein kuchla, kale track pe unche ilaake ki taraf.

Peeche mashal ki roshni gehri hui. Ab tooti deewar se nayi lehar sipahiyon ki bah rahi thi, aur zyada, tang patthar ki shelf pe bharte, aur baarish mein tumhari aakhri peeche jhaank ek chhoti akeli shakl thi sabke beech — abhi khadi, abhi hilti, abhi aadmiyon ko sirf haath-pair aur natoot, antooti marzi se hatati.
Phir track muda, aur patthar tumhare beech uth gaye, aur wo nazron se gayab — par nahi, tumne toofan mein kasam khayi, poori tarah gayab nahi.
— Chapter 18 khatam —

Tum bhaagte rahe jab tak nadi door neeche chaandi ka dhaaga na ban gayi aur qila door mashalon ka jhund, jab tak phephde aag na ho gaye aur behen ke pair fail na hone lage. Tum bhaagte rahe jab tak zameen sakht oopar na jhuki aur kale pahaad aage bade na uth khade hue, aur jab Nessa ek kadam aur nahi le saki tab ruke, patthar ke oonche thande kandhe pe, mude, aur us raaste pe dekha jahan se aaye the.
Bahut, bahut neeche, paani ke upar us chhoti patthar ki shelf pe, tum abhi bhi use dekh sakte the. Aur dil ruk gaya.
Ab teen sipahi nahi thaam rahi thi. Dus thaam rahi thi.

Ek akeli shakl mashalon ke daayre mein, peeche kaali nadi, aage dus hathiyar band aadmi bandhata chaap — aur wo abhi bhi nange haath lad rahi thi, jaise maa ke ghar ne aangan mein sikhaya tha, ek jung aur ek zindagi door.

Itni bhayankar doori pe bhi tum forms padh sakte the: wo bhalla seedha kabhi nahi milati, ghumati, peeche nikal jati, aadmi ke khud ke wazan ko uske khilaaf use karti; ek baar, sakht, bilkul jahan khula ho, maarti, aur girne se pehle hil chuki hoti. Gale pe hatheli. Ghutne ke peeche edi. Ghumao jo do ko andhere mein ek doosre pe girata.
Center thaame raho, purani awaaz andar boli, dhoop wali subah jaisi shaant. Dus aadmi ek saath tum tak nahi pahunch sakte. Unhe bari do. Har ek se keemat lo.
Tum nahi jaante the — jaan nahi sakte the — waisa dikhane ki keemat kya thi.

Jo shareer itna khoobsurat hil raha tha, uske andar sab ek saath fail ho raha tha. Bhookhi muscles bache thode ko bhi jala rahi thin. Collarbone ke neeche daag khal ke neeche koyla tha. Seene pe lash-zakhm poori tarah phat chuke the aur baarish barbaad dress ke aage se gulabi beh rahi thi. Marode kandhe har block pe cheekhte. Aur nange pair aur pinne, geele patthar pe dhajjiyan, har kadam pe kaale nishan chhodte.
Ek aur, usne khud se kaha, jab koi aur aadmi aaya. Ek saans. Ek form. Ek aur, aur wo pahaad se ek saans door. Thaame raho. Bas thaame.

Phata skirt sipahiyon jitna hi ladta tha. Geela, phaada kapda ghutnon pe ulajhta, laatein chheeneta, har pivot pe balance daraata, aur do baar larai ke beech ek haath se phaadna pada, gusse se, inkaar ki ek kapde ka tukda wo kare jo dus aadmi nahi kar sake.

Usne nahi karne diya. Kasakar baandha, khoon bharte pair aur chaure kiye, center neeche rakha, aur chalti rahi — kyunki kale pahaad pe kahin do log the jinhe usne bachane ka faisla kiya tha abhi chadhte, aur uske khoon ki princess nahi rukti jab tak doori kharidne ko ek saans bachi ho.
Isi ke liye main hoon, usne socha, dard ke dhundhlepan mein almost hairaan. Spring nahi. Takht nahi. Ye. Jinhe pyar karti hoon unke aur andhere ke beech khadi. Ye hi ho.
Aur phir, aakhir, wo chhoot gayi.

Ek waar nahi tha. Do saal ek saath wasool — cradle, press, daag, strappado, bina khane-paani-neend ke din — aur shareer, chahe kitna bahadur, seekha, shahi, itna hi kharch ho sakta usse pehle khinchne ko kuch na bache.

Uske pair, kate khoon bhare aur kamapte, aakhir jawab nahi diya. Ooncha block ek dhadkan late. Pivot nahi ghuma. Khoobsurat, behti forms atki aur toot gayi, aur pehli baar aadmiyon ka daayra usse tez tha.
Ek guard ne peeche se pakda, dono kalaiyan mutthiyon mein.
Tab bhi — kharch, khatam — bas haar nahi maani. Wazan giraya, pakad ke andar mudi jaise forms sikhate, ek haath chhudaya aur kohni itni zor peeche maari ki wo mud gaya aur chhod diya.
Par ye uska aakhri tha. Uske baad kuch nahi. Aur baaki ne bhi dekh liya.

Chaar ek saath uspe bandhe. Phir paanch. Unhone baaju, kandhe pakde, shareeron ke wazan se neeche dabaya, warrior ko armored aadmiyon ke press ke neeche jakda jo ek minute pehle uske paas aane ki himmat nahi karte.
Aur phir bhi — Bhagwan, phir bhi — ladi. Kamzor, dagmagati, thakaan aur dard se aadhi andhi, haathon ke khilaaf tani, marodti, sthir hone se inkaar, kyunki sthir hona wo cheez hai jo use aati nahi.
Pahaad se tumne dekha aur saans nahi le paaye. Nessa ne chehra tumhari bagal mein dabaya taaki na dekhna pade.

Wo jaanti thi. Andar koi saaf, shaant hissa, ab bhi, bilkul jaanta tha ye kaise khatam hota hai — poori fauj ek bhookhi, chains-se-azad princess ke khilaaf geele patthar ki patti pe, aur hisab ka ek hi jawab. Jeetna nahi tha. Kabhi nahi tha.

Phir bhi ladi. Jo kuch bhi rooh bachi, jo aakhri forms shareer abhi yaad rakhta, aise ladi jaise ending jaanti hi na ho — kyunki larai jeetne ki nahi thi. Second ki thi, aur har second tum aur Nessa kale pahaadon mein ek kadam door unki pahunch se.

Aur phir, ek saans aur agli ke beech, andhera bas utha aur nazren nigal gaya. Shareer — princess ka shareer, taakat ko janma, uthaya, usi ke liye bana — dene ko kuch nahi; cradle aur press aur daag aur bhookh ke mahinon ne aakhri kharch kar diya. Ghutne mude. Mashal ki roshni dhundhli aur bujhi. Geele patthar pe fold hui, girne se pehle behosh.

Uske taraf se ho gaya. Unhe kaafi der thaame rakha. Do log jinhe pyar karti thi safe the, door kale pahaad pe jahan aaj raat koi sipahi nahi aayega — aur aakhri thartharate pal mein andhera aane se pehle, ye jaankar, muskurayi. Phir behosh ho gayi.
Phir, patli hoti baarish mein, tumne use aate dekha.
Vance. Ab bina jaldi. Mashal ki roshni mein chalta, dono haath mein chains ikatthi, time leta, maza leta — iklauta inaam jo poori raat mana nahi kar saki.

Unhone uska dheela, behosh shareer thaame rakha jab usne chains lagayi. Pehle kalaiyan. Phir lohe ka collar. Phir lambi, bhaari chain — wapas uspe lock, link-link, har loha cheez jisse wo khule aasmaan ke neeche azaad hone khadi hui thi, ab ek aurat pe kasaa jo itni door chali gayi thi ki band hote mehsoos bhi na kare.
Wapas chalana mumkin nahi tha. Wo usse kaafi aage nikal chuki thi.

Do sipahiyon ne bagalon se pakda aur dheele ko beech mein khincha, kate nange pair geele patthar pe ghisate, kata sir dheela latakta. Jo princess ek ghante pehle dus hathiyar band aadmiyon ko rok rahi thi, use behosh uthakar gate ki taraf le gaye, usi qile mein jisse nikalne ke liye usne khoon bahaya, ladi, aur khud ka aakhri kharch kiya.
Wo andhera jisse usne tumse kabhi na lene ko kaha tha, use wapas le raha tha, aur is duniya pe ek cheez nahi thi jo tum hazaar feet upar pahaad se kar sakte.
Tum us oonche patthar ke kandhe pe khade unhe uski behosh shakl patthar se neeche le jaate dekhte rahe, aur saans nahi, hil nahi sakte the, aur nazar nahi hata sakte the.
Zindagi bhar har raat aankhon ke peeche ye dikhega: sir latakta, baaju dheele, kalaiyon pe chains hilti, mashal ki roshni nigalti, andhera phir uspe band.

Bagal, Nessa ne chehra tumhari bagal mein dabaya aur roi, aur tumne use thaama, aur kisi ne ek shabd nahi kaha, kyunki duniya mein koi shabd nahi bacha tha jo tumne abhi use tumhare khatir karte dekha.
Par us pal tumne ek cheez thaame rakhi, aur dinon ke baaki bhi thaame rahoge.

Aakhri cheez jo usne ki, wahan dus aadmiyon ke beech, pehle ki andhera utha aur le gaya — tum itne door the ki sach mein dekh nahi sakte the, aur phir bhi jaante the, jaise hamesha use jaante the: wo muskurayi thi.

Usne khud ki aakhri boond kharch ki aur iklauti jeet jeeti jo kabhi chahi thi — tumhari — aur jaante hue tum dono door kale pahaad pe azaad aur na pakde, chhod diya aur andhere mein khushi se utri. Chehra ek aurat ka jisne sab kho diya aur kuch nahi pachtaya.
Phir unhone use gate se khincha, aur qile ka andhera princess pe phir band hua, aur wo nahi hili.
Tum thande pahaad pe khade, behen ka haath mutthi mein kuchla, peeche grey subah uthati — azaad, aur barbaad, aur bilkul ek cheez pe pakke.
"Main tumhe lene wapas aaunga," tumne hawa mein kaha jo use nahi le ja sakti thi. "Jo bhi lage. Kitni bhi der. Main wapas aaunga. Kasam — abhi ye end nahi hai."
— Jaari rahega… —
